questions.question: In his letter to the church in Thessalonica, Paul wished them grace and peace from whom?

answers.text: God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ
Paul and the churches of Judea
The apostles and elders in Jerusalem

questions.question: Paul praised the Thessalonian church for keeping their perseverance and faith while enduring what?

answers.text: A long famine in the land

questions.question: Paul told the Thessalonian church that their suffering showed they were not worthy of the kingdom of God. True or false?
Paul wrote that when the Lord Jesus is revealed from heaven in blazing fire, whom will He punish?

answers.text: Those who do not know God and do not obey the gospel
Those who never kept the feasts in Jerusalem
Those who never made an offering at the temple
